maddeler.e:
أتشخبط (form IIq)
# أَتَشَخْبَطُ (ʔatašaḵbaṭu) /ʔa.ta.ʃax.ba.tˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَشَخْبَطَ (tašaḵbaṭa)
# أَتَشَخْبَطَ (ʔatašaḵbaṭa) /ʔa.ta.ʃax.ba.tˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَشَخْبَطَ (tašaḵbaṭa)
# أَتَشَخْبَطْ (ʔatašaḵbaṭ) /ʔa.ta.ʃax.batˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَشَخْبَطَ (tašaḵbaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
